visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses and a black baseball cap holds a light-colored leopard gecko in his hands, smiling warmly toward the camera. He wears a red and black varsity jacket in a brightly lit, slightly blurred indoor exhibition setting. (2) A transition reveals a large outdoor banner for the '2025 Taiwan Reptile Festival' mounted on a modern exhibition building under a clear blue sky. The camera pans across the venue's exterior architecture. (3) Rapid close-up shots showcase diverse exotic animals: a textured orange crested gecko, a pristine white python being held by hands, and a black-and-yellow salamander resting on a palm. (4) An expansive wide shot and ground-level views depict a massive exhibition hall filled with dense crowds of visitors walking between rows of booths under bright industrial lighting. (5) On-screen graphics display a map of the Taichung International Exhibition Center with pin markers for nearby transport links like the HSR and train stations. (6) The man interacts with a large horned beetle on a piece of wood, while other scenes show visitors enjoying ice cream and viewing displays of framed butterflies. (7) Performers in orange jumpsuits dance alongside a large, lifelike dinosaur puppet amidst a cheering crowd in the hall. (8) Posters for special sub-exhibitions like 'Mofun Park' and 'Turtle Exhibit' are displayed as high-quality graphics. (9) A stage event shows a host drawing a lucky ticket from a black box, followed by a promotional image of a PlayStation 5 console. (10) The man returns to the screen, now holding a black snake around his neck, gesturing excitedly to the camera against a colorful graphic background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop music with a driving 4/4 beat and bright synthesizer leads begins immediately. A male voice delivers a fast-paced, enthusiastic narration in Traditional Chinese, characterized by a high-arousal tone and friendly prosody. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a visual transition to the outdoor venue. The narrator's voice maintains a consistent high pitch variability, emphasizing key promotional phrases. Music remains at a steady tempo of approximately 135 BPM. (3) During the close-up montage of animals, subtle 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects are synchronized with text overlays appearing on screen. The ambient noise floor of the exhibition hall, featuring muffled chatter and distant crowd murmur, is audible under the main mix. (4) As the map is shown, a digital 'ui-click' sound effect accompanies the appearance of pin markers. The narrator's speech density is high, providing logistical information without pauses. (5) A percussive 'hit' or 'impact' SFX punctuates the reveal of the lucky draw prize. The music's bass rhythm becomes more prominent to build excitement. (6) The video concludes with a final hard cut to silence. The narrator's voice ends on a rising intonation, inviting viewers to participate in the upcoming festival.
